remarks: Highest and best by Wednesday, 8/6, at 5:00 pm. Preferred closing date is 10/7. Discover 50 Nursery Street, a beautifully maintained home on a tranquil street in West Norwalk, minutes to New Canaan and Darien. This 2,614 square foot residence is set on over an acre and offers three bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms. The main level layout includes an updated kitchen with recent appliances: a refrigerator and dishwasher from 2020, a microwave and oven from 2021, and a washer and dryer from 2022. Other recent updates are a new roof and gutters (2021), Hardie Board siding (2022), and a water tank (2024). Don't miss the walk-up attic. The finished walk-out lower level adds versatile space with a rec room, workshop, full bath, and an office/bedroom with a private entrance and fireplace. The screened-in porch and yard provide ideal spots for relaxation and entertaining. Experience the blend of privacy and community in this West Norwalk haven.
